metadata.description: Original Greenbox seedling garden: a warm layered 6 by 5.2 meter outdoor voxel tile with broad lime and olive cube tree canopies, a stepped sand path, a turquoise pond, fish, lily pads, square reeds, an oak bench, flowers, plank fence, SEED marker, a new compact Rasta grower, preserved CC0-leaf-derived potted plant assets and a watering can. Source shapes are occupied cubes and colors remain the canonical indexed Greenbox palette. Garden theme is a global presentation remap. Static game art diorama only.
